remote_resources.identifier: UNISA H100, aiq partition, GPU compute ainode01/ainode02
remote_resources.source: earlier workstation/UNISA acquisitions and HBM4PiM research branch
remote_resources.claim: Existing H100 model and profiler acquisition source/scripts are accessible through GitHub; raw on-host measurements not mounted in this environment

remote_resources.access: SOURCE_READ_ONLY; native model can be executed only where its vendored local dependencies are present
remote_resources.limitations: Existing LLMCompass native A100 FP16 GQA-operator adapter lacks RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE and full optimized Hydragen/suffix GPU kernel; H100 BF16 exact decoder timing not established

existing_source_evidence.qualification: Two shape-compatible isolated real H100 GEMM measurements only. Not full-attention, full decoder, per-model quality or functional shared-prefix benchmark

mistral.note: On-host H100 acquisitions cannot be retagged to BF16 or to a distinct pinned checkpoint. Their serving prompt lengths do not include the 2048+128 reference geometry

opt.quality_evaluation_variant: BF16 explicit model copy, not source FP16

missing_publication_gates: Direct CUDA runtime on UNISA/workstation/H100, raw archived model/cache, or an allowed attached GPU runner
Kernel benchmark for each of 128 decode steps, exact model geometry/dtype, Flash and shared-prefix candidate, source CUDA events and kernel proof
Matched pretrained Llama GQA BF16 decoder hooks and profile plus corresponding Mistral/OPT on their own revisions
Qualified SRAM source K/key links, CIM programming/output bandwidth, reduction and external support area
OPT/Mistral R0-R3 inference + development-only ADC calibration on matching BF16-capable CUDA device
publication_conclusion: No positive competitive region is established; exclusion relative to optimized GPU cannot be recalculated until exact measured GPU attention at same functional endpoint. Historical 2ms regions are deadline sensitivities only.
